label: Bruiser Brody

won.source: Defeated the champion Faarooq in a broken-glass match at the fed's own PPV, introducing the title (/promotions/aolwf/archive/in-your-house-up-your-ass-1997-07-16.html).

how: Broken-glass match; Faarooq flew through a pane of glass off a reversed Irish whip.

won.source: Billed for the titles against the Pitbulls at the fed's own PPV (/promotions/aolwf/archive/in-your-house-up-your-ass-1997-07-16.html); the surviving parts do not carry the match's own finish, which is corroborated by this tag's own source digest.

won.source: Pinned champion Jushin Liger (Frankenchyna) at the fed's own PPV, becoming the first female AOLWF champion (/promotions/aolwf/archive/in-your-house-up-your-ass-1997-07-16.html).

how: Pinfall, after interference wrote her into the match in place of the injured originally-scheduled challenger.
